repos.name: openai/math
repos.one_liner: A formal repository of mathematical problems and proofs using the Lean theorem prover.
bullets: Built using the Lean 4 programming language and formal verification framework.
Provides a structured, machine-verifiable library of complex mathematical reasoning.
Essential for AI-LLM research in automated theorem proving and formal logic verification.
Serves as a benchmark for evaluating the mathematical reasoning capabilities of next-gen LLMs.

repos.name: SonicloudTech/mouse-mcp
repos.description: Hardware mouse MCP server for AI agents on Windows x64. USB HID control and voice dictation; requires compatible uMouse hardware and firmware. 面向 AI 智能体的硬件鼠标 MCP：USB HID 控制与语音听写，需要兼容的 uMouse 设备与固件。
repos.one_liner: A hardware-integrated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling AI agents to control physical mouse inputs.
bullets: Developed in TypeScript, acting as a bridge between LLM agents and physical USB HID hardware.
Enables agentic workflows to perform precise GUI interactions on Windows systems.
Supports voice dictation and hardware-level mouse control for automation tasks.
Ideal for building autonomous agents that require real-world desktop interaction capabilities.

repos.name: google-gemini/gemini-api-cli
repos.description: An (experimental) CLI for the Gemini API
repos.one_liner: An experimental command-line interface for interacting with Google's Gemini API.
bullets: Written in Go, providing a lightweight and performant interface for LLM integration.
Facilitates rapid prototyping and testing of Gemini model capabilities directly from the terminal.
Useful for developers building AI-powered CLI tools or automated infrastructure scripts.
Simplifies authentication and request handling for Gemini's multimodal API endpoints.

repos.name: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
repos.description: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.
repos.one_liner: An open-source AI-powered desktop tool for automatically clipping and repurposing long-form video content.
bullets: Python-based architecture leveraging AI models for video segmentation and content analysis.
Automates the generation of subtitles, thumbnails, and social media-ready short-form clips.
Streamlines content marketing workflows for creators and media-focused fintech startups.
Supports multi-platform output optimization for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

repos.name: kunkundi/crossdesk
repos.description: A lightweight, cross-platform remote desktop software with support for Web Client access | 一款支持 Web 客户端访问的轻量级跨平台远程桌面软件。
repos.one_liner: A lightweight, cross-platform remote desktop solution featuring native Web Client support.
bullets: Developed in C++ for high-performance, low-latency remote access.
Provides a secure infrastructure layer for remote server management and desktop virtualization.
Includes a browser-based Web Client, eliminating the need for local software installation.
Applicable for secure remote development environments and distributed team infrastructure.
